_comment: PLACEHOLDER boundary polygon for the Marigaon (HYBAS_ID 4120883730) demo watershed. This is NOT the real MWS/HydroBASINS boundary - it is a hand-drawn irregular polygon in roughly the right part of Morigaon district, Assam, sized like a plausible micro-watershed (~5-8km across). It exists only to unblock Phase 1 per PRD.md §10 FR1.5, which explicitly allows this. Swap this file for the real boundary GeoJSON whenever it's available - scripts/config/watershed.yaml's boundary_path is the only thing that needs to change, no code changes required.
